meta.title: New England Contech-for-Cleantech Audit 2026
meta.description: Field test of the 2022 three-actor model (Podder et al., NREL/CP-5500-83262) across New England. Independent update, not NREL-affiliated.

states.notes: MassCEC TDA ($20M/yr) + CriticalMass ($3M/yr) + InnovateMass ($350K). Barr funds workforce/equity, not startups. Holcim invests in Sublime Systems (MA cement).
states.built_env_signal: Buildings = 36% of state emissions; Holcim/Sublime acquisition anchored in MA

states.notes: CT Green Bank (statutory) + CI's $100M ClimateTech Fund naming the built environment explicitly (e.g. CarbonBuilt). Only stale, sector-generic exits on acquisition.
states.primary_institutions: CT Green Bank + CT Innovations ClimateTech Fund ($100M)
states.built_env_signal: Fund names 'Built Environment' as explicit focus; CarbonBuilt, Enertiv in portfolio; C-PACE most mature in region

states.notes: DeltaClimeVT accelerator + utility pilots (Burlington Electric). No capital institution behind it.
states.built_env_signal: Utility pilots as validation; 2025 cohort focused on building/heating electrification

states.notes: MTI + Roux Institute incubator + Weatherization Business Lab. Building apparatus from lowest base in NE.
states.primary_institutions: Maine Technology Institute + Roux Institute incubator
states.built_env_signal: Weatherization Business Lab scaling efficiency contractors

states.notes: Renewable Energy Fund = project deployment grants only. No green bank, no early-stage equity.
states.built_env_signal: REF funds small-scale solar/community renewables, not startups

states.notes: CDFA Clean Energy Fund (~$9M loan fund). Gap-filling via Clean Energy NH nonprofit circuit riders. State actively retreating.
states.primary_institutions: CDFA Clean Energy Fund (~$9M); Clean Energy NH (nonprofit)
states.built_env_signal: Offshore wind office downgraded; $43.5M low-income solar clawed back
